# Support My Local Community (SMLC)

> Free community portal for Clay County, Illinois (Central Time). Local events, news, gas prices, weather and businesses for Clay City, Flora, Louisville, Sailor Springs and Xenia.

## Pages
- [Clay County home](https://supportmylocalcommunity.com/): county-wide events, news, partners and business directory
- [Clay City, IL](https://supportmylocalcommunity.com/clay-city.html): Clay City events, news, gas prices, weather, landmarks and history (ZIP 62824)
- [Flora, IL](https://supportmylocalcommunity.com/flora.html): Flora events, news, gas prices, weather, landmarks and history (ZIP 62839)
- [Louisville, IL](https://supportmylocalcommunity.com/louisville.html): Louisville events, news, gas prices, weather, landmarks and history (ZIP 62858)
- [Sailor Springs, IL](https://supportmylocalcommunity.com/sailor-springs.html): Sailor Springs events, news, gas prices, weather, landmarks and history (ZIP 62879)
- [Xenia, IL](https://supportmylocalcommunity.com/xenia.html): Xenia events, news, gas prices, weather, landmarks and history (ZIP 62899)

## Key facts
- Clay County, Illinois is in the Central Time Zone; all times on the site are Central.
- Louisville is the Clay County seat. Flora is the largest city.
- Submit an event (free): https://www.supportmylocalcommunity.com/submit-event
- Clay County Business Directory: https://clay-county-business-directory.supportmylocalcommunity.com/
- Contact: info@supportmylocalcommunity.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SupportMyLocalCommunity
